description: This header file defines the RialtoConnector class, which manages session states and interactions with the Rialto server manager within the WPEFramework namespace. It declares methods for initializing the connector, managing session states (create, resume, suspend, deactivate), and observing state changes.

classes.name: RialtoConnector
classes.description: Manages Rialto session states, interfaces with the server manager service, and observes state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoConnector and sets up the server manager service.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Blocks until a specified application changes to a desired state or timeout occurs.

methods.name: createAppSession
methods.description: Creates a new application session with the given callsign, displayName, and appId.

methods.name: resumeSession
methods.description: Resumes the session associated with the given callsign.

methods.name: suspendSession
methods.description: Suspends the session associated with the given callsign.

methods.name: deactivateSession
methods.description: Deactivates the session associated with the given callsign.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the application state changes, updates internal state mapping.
